integrity: The full primary PDF was inspected at Theorem 1.1, Proposition 3.1, Definitions 3.4, 3.6, 3.9, 3.13, 3.15, Theorem 3.20, and the final syntax analysis. Every temporal occurrence in the lower reduction is visibly X or XX, the agent and proposition vocabularies are fixed once, and the injectivizing padding is propositional.
scientific_limitations: The result fixes five agents and five propositions but does not reduce either number, does not bound strategy-quantifier alternation, and does not apply to a fixed finite action set. The depth-two bound is not claimed optimal.
title: Depth-two fixed-vocabulary Strategy Logic is already second-order complete
